title.zh-CN: 水肿、少尿与反复腹痛 · 36岁女性
title.en: Oedema, oliguria and recurrent abdominal pain · woman aged 36

summary.zh-CN: 水肿和血尿先于两次腹部手术，随后少尿加重。重建跨器官时间线，核对免疫及病理证据。
summary.en: Oedema and haematuria preceded two abdominal operations before worsening oliguria. Reconstruct the multi-organ timeline and review immunological and pathological evidence.

answer.zh-CN: 先因腹痛按阑尾炎做了手术，之后又腹痛、恶心、呕吐、腹泻，因肠套叠切除了升结肠。
answer.en: An operation was first performed for presumed appendicitis; later pain, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea led to ascending-colon resection for intussusception.

answer.en: Antihypertensive and diuretic treatment was used, including outpatient amlodipine; propylthiouracil exposure was denied.

text.zh-CN: 肌酐从261、351、679升至700 μmol/L；入院尿蛋白+++、24小时尿蛋白2.31 g，红细胞30–40/HPF。
text.en: Creatinine rose through 261, 351 and 679 to 700 μmol/L. At admission urine protein was +++, 24-hour protein 2.31 g and RBCs 30–40/HPF.

text.zh-CN: pANCA阳性，MPO抗体115000 RU/L（参考<20000）；抗GBM、ANA及抗dsDNA阴性。
text.en: pANCA positive, MPO antibody 115000 RU/L (reference <20000); anti-GBM, ANA and anti-dsDNA negative.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

text.zh-CN: 免疫荧光阴性。5个肾小球均见新月体：2个细胞性、2个细胞纤维性、1个纤维性；毛细血管袢严重破坏，符合Ⅲ型新月体肾炎。
text.en: Immunofluorescence was negative. All five sampled glomeruli had crescents: two cellular, two fibrocellular and one fibrous, with severe capillary-tuft damage, consistent with type III crescentic glomerulonephritis.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

text.zh-CN: 黏膜糜烂、溃疡和重度水肿，血管充血并炎细胞浸润；讨论中复阅描述小动脉周围炎细胞及个别血管纤维素样坏死，支持消化道受累。
text.en: Mucosal erosions, ulcers and marked oedema with congested vessels and inflammatory infiltrates; the discussion’s re-review describes periarteriolar inflammation and focal fibrinoid vascular necrosis, supporting gastrointestinal involvement.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

text.zh-CN: 血红蛋白85 g/L，白细胞12×10⁹/L，血小板332×10⁹/L，ESR 78 mm/h，CRP 15.3 mg/L。
text.en: Haemoglobin 85 g/L, WBC 12×10⁹/L, platelets 332×10⁹/L, ESR 78 mm/h and CRP 15.3 mg/L.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

text.zh-CN: 报告使用透析、糖皮质激素及环磷酰胺，并给予肺孢子菌预防。尿量回升至1300–1500 mL/日后脱离透析；肌酐先降至约200，后120 μmol/L，尿检及炎症指标恢复正常，无腹痛。记录未给出长期复发情况。
text.en: The report used dialysis, corticosteroids and cyclophosphamide with Pneumocystis prophylaxis. Urine output rose to 1300–1500 mL/day and dialysis was stopped; creatinine fell first to about 200 and later 120 μmol/L, with normal urine/inflammatory tests and no abdominal pain. Long-term relapse status is not given.

text.en: ANCA-associated small-vessel vasculitis with pauci-immune crescentic glomerulonephritis and gastrointestinal involvement

feedback.zh-CN: 肾脏异常早于手术，抗体和活检形成独立的证据链，肠病理支持系统受累。
feedback.en: Renal abnormalities preceded surgery; serology and biopsy form an independent evidence chain, with bowel pathology supporting systemic involvement.

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 跨器官时间线与血清、肾病理相互印证，治疗后报告肾功能恢复并脱离透析。
conclusion.en: The multi-organ chronology, serology and renal pathology are concordant; renal recovery and dialysis independence were reported after treatment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 不要把所有肾损伤归因于术后，因为蛋白尿、血尿和肌酐升高早已存在。
keyReasoning.en: Do not attribute all kidney injury to surgery: proteinuria, haematuria and elevated creatinine preceded it.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 无紫癜并不能推翻已获得的抗体与病理证据。
keyReasoning.en: Absent purpura does not negate the serological and pathological evidence.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.
